meta.access_policy: ATTENTION: AGENTS MUST ONLY READ OR OPERATE THIS TEMPLATE THROUGH THE xc-orchestration-author SKILL AND ITS PUBLIC COMMANDS. DO NOT OPEN, SUMMARIZE, EDIT, PATCH, OR REFORMAT THIS FILE DIRECTLY.

node.title: Prepare new feature
node.instructions: Read the project bridge, open the work order through xc-open-work-order, determine and validate work_order.document_language through xc-document from the explicit parameter or initiating user request, select an explicit feature ID, and create its empty directory through xc-feature. Write the report commitment work_order.requires_report in this same preparation step, resolved through the report policy rather than from the mode alone: an explicit user instruction first, then the project bridge which may only tighten, then report.default in the workshop configuration, then the built-in default. The shipped code-change-only tier means true for change, repair, and maintenance and false for investigation and review, and true when the mode cannot be confirmed, because an unknown mode is never interpreted as no report needed. Record work_order.report_baseline once, as the baseline commit, the worktree digest and the digest algorithm, and record work_order.report_skip_reason whenever the report is deliberately skipped. All three are preparation-phase records, never retrospective notes, and a missing commitment fails this node.
node.deliverables: An authoritative workbench and empty managed feature directory.
node.acceptance: The workshop Git worktree is independent, the feature ID is explicit, work_order.document_language is set before any document write, no baseline document exists outside document evolution, and the mode-derived report commitment is written rather than assumed: work_order.requires_report carries the value the resolved report policy produced, every skip records one of the legal work_order.report_skip_reason values (read_only_mode, zero_analyzable_units, user_waived, policy_default), work_order.report_baseline records the baseline commit, the worktree digest and the digest algorithm, and a missing commitment fails this node.

node.title: Approve feature baseline
node.instructions: Present the accepted contract, feature solution, verification baseline, and work order solution. Record approval or requested revision through the runtime.
node.deliverables: A recorded approval decision or follow-up document-evolution nodes.
node.acceptance: The feature baseline is approved or the tree contains explicit revision and review work.

node.title: Produce change review report
node.instructions: Produce the change report for this work order after verification and before the result document. The group is mounted by the commitment value work_order.requires_report. Embed the xc-change-report subtree once under this group, or run a single role=report node that carries the same contract. Resolve the subtree's template path from the committed setup record at .agents/.xcoding-setup/manifest.json, which holds the installed xc-change-report package's absolute path; change-report-template.xml is read from it, and the host-to-Skill-root table is the fallback for a project with no such record. Before the group's first node runs, publish all thirteen caller-seeded keys with the values this work order actually uses, never merely accepting their declared defaults: report.path, report.manifest_path, report.baseline_commit, report.baseline_digest, report.language, report.strength, report.gate_required, report.gate_outcome, report.gate_rework_required, report.gate_recovery_required, report.round, report.refresh_count, and report.refresh_reason. report.round is the 1-based index of the pass being entered. When prepare-manifest measures one or more analyzable units, produce the report; when it measures zero analyzable units, record work_order.report_skip_reason=zero_analyzable_units and produce no report; a user waiver records work_order.report_skip_reason=user_waived, and a skip the resolved report policy produced records work_order.report_skip_reason=policy_default. A skipped gate records report.gate_outcome=not-run, never accepted.
node.deliverables: On the produced outcome: one change-report.html, one change-report-manifest.json, and one change-report-verdicts.json under the workbench report node artifact directory. On the skipped outcome: no report file is required, and the deliverable is the recorded work_order.report_skip_reason with report.run_required=false.
node.acceptance: Exactly one of the two outcomes holds: either the report exists at report.path and is proven by report.manifest_path, or report.run_required is false and work_order.report_skip_reason records one of the legal reasons (read_only_mode, zero_analyzable_units, user_waived, policy_default); a produced report is never accepted without its manifest, and a skip is never accepted without its reason. The caller publishes all thirteen caller-seeded report.* keys with the values this work order uses before the group's first node runs, and the subtree's template is resolved from the installed package path the setup record holds, so the guards and completion-fact selectors the subtree evaluates resolve against those thirteen declarations or against a key one of the subtree's own nodes writes before that expression reads it.

node.title: Finalize new feature work order
node.instructions: Confirm the result, feature baseline provenance, declared artifacts, and validation evidence, then close the work order. Consume work_order.report_skip_reason: when work_order.requires_report is true and neither a report path nor one of the legal skip reasons (read_only_mode, zero_analyzable_units, user_waived, policy_default) is recorded, the work order must not close.
node.deliverables: A completed, failed, or blocked work order with durable result evidence.
node.acceptance: The runtime tree and declared workbench artifacts accurately represent the outcome, and a committed report obligation is either satisfied by a report path or explicitly recorded as a skip decision.
